```sql
WITH facturacion_mensual AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', p.fecha) AS mes,
        SUM(i.cantidad * i.precio_unitario) AS facturacion
    FROM pedidos p
    JOIN items i ON i.pedido_id = p.pedido_id
    WHERE p.estado = 'entregado'
      AND p.fecha BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY mes
)
SELECT 
    mes,
    facturacion,
    SUM(facturacion) OVER (ORDER BY mes
                           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS acumulado
FROM facturacion_mensual
ORDER BY mes;
```
